lines.zh: : 因为每个人都有底线。如果我误解了什么，我先道歉——不过在我看来，你像是在{i}试探{/i}我的底线。

lines.zh: : 你能保证永远不对我隐瞒{i}任何事{/i}吗？

lines.en: : On another note, what would you like for dinner tonight? I was thinking of making hamburger steak.

lines.en: : {i}I don’t know, but you need to get out of here.{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I can handle her just fine. But I want you to get out of here before you get roped into one more thing you’re not meant to be a part of.{/i}

lines.en: : Ami...can I talk to you in your room for a minute?
lines.zh: : Ami……我能去你房间跟你说几句吗？

lines.en: : My room? Why? Have to give your prisoner some time to escape?
lines.zh: : 我房间？为什么？得给你的囚犯留点时间逃跑？
